# zju-connect v1.3.1 source

`zju-connect-v1.3.1-source.zip` is the unmodified source archive for the
zju-connect v1.3.1 Windows amd64 binary that is bundled in the **full** plugin
package. It is included as the Corresponding Source under AGPL-3.0.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/Mythologyli/zju-connect
- Pinned tag: https://github.com/Mythologyli/zju-connect/releases/tag/v1.3.1
- Archive URL: https://github.com/Mythologyli/zju-connect/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.1.zip
- Archive SHA-256: `FA131DDA15A053E4D3D51F2BA0B79278B5129AF6FA7E5AFFC05EAFC2ECA825AB`
- Bundled binary SHA-256: `AEE7D8DBBF4DB98FBFF2B36D657094D95F3F6209DC3168914C62AEA01A8732BE`
- License: AGPL-3.0 (the repository-wide `LICENSE` is the same license text;
  the archive also contains the upstream `LICENSE`).

The binary is unmodified. Keep this archive, `LICENSE`, and
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` together when redistributing the full package. The
slim package does not contain the executable and downloads it from upstream
through `bin/install-zju-connect.ps1`.
